guidelines.detail: refines FLOW-07 (The records show omitted elements and flows for the repeated review-and-change cycle, including a feedback activity and decision point. The description supports that cycle, and FLOW-07 already addresses loops and meaningful exits; this guideline adds how to model a feedback-driven review cycle.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The description supports the specific activity and outcome meanings reflected in the label pairs, while some generated labels add or alter details. FID-03 already requires short, faithful labels and meaningful event triggers or outcomes, so the proposed guidance is already documented.)

same as LRN-027 (The description supports optional repeated assessment with changes based on feedback, and states that changes are documented and approved. The generated flow cycles back to an earlier review without the reference gateway structure, supporting a decision-controlled cycle. This is essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-027.)

same as LRN-016 (The label pairs show differences in specificity and action wording, while the description provides the details needed to keep labels faithful. This is already covered essentially by learned guideline LRN-016.)

same as LRN-027 (The description explicitly allows several review-and-adjustment rounds. The missing gateway and flows, together with the generated direct flow from review to the next stage and return flow, support modeling an explicit decision about whether to repeat the cycle or continue. This is essentially the same guidance as LRN-027.)

same as LRN-009 (The generated labels often add detail beyond the central activity or outcome, while the description supports concise labels. This is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-009.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says work may be evaluated and changed repeatedly in response to evaluation feedback: Model a decision-controlled cycle that routes work needing further changes back for another evaluation and lets work needing no further changes proceed. Model providing feedback as a separate activity when the description states that it is performed work.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says work may be evaluated and changed repeatedly in response to evaluation feedback

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or process outcome with a discernible action, object, or completion condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description gives an activity with multiple evaluation dimensions or optional methods, or states a completion outcome in detail: Use concise labels for the corresponding BPMN activities and events, preserving the central action or outcome without enumerating subsidiary details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or outcome together with supporting context or details
